messages:
Rae: Heads-up 12: support noticed a confusing inline error when users hit rate/quotas in the Console. Current message: 'Quota exceeded'. Need better UX and actionable CTAs. Screenshot in Figma.
Ben: Yikes, 'Quota exceeded' is vague. Is it a per-minute rate limit, per-day billing quota, or an org-wide cap? We should surface the scope + next steps.
Lina: Agreed. Propose schema: short headline, one-line explainer with scope + ETA if possible, primary action (upgrade/ retry/ contact support), and a subtle help link. Example: 'You9re at your plan limit. Upgrade to increase your quota.'
Mark: Also think about transient rate limits vs billing caps. For rate limits: 'Too many requests right now. Try again in 60s' for billing caps: 'You9ve used your monthly quota. Upgrade or contact billing.' Different CTAs.
legal-bot: Note: copy mentioning times must be conservative. Use 'approximately' or 'typically' unless exact. Avoid promises like 'instant'.
Rae: Accessibility points: the inline error should be announced via role="alert" when it appears, and the primary CTA should have an aria-describedby linking to the help text. Screen readers need the scope in the announcement (e.g., 'project-level rate limit').
Ben: Copy variants to review (shortlist):
1) Rate-limit friendly (transient): Title: 'Too many requests' Body: 'You9re sending requests faster than our system allows. Please wait about a minute and try again.' CTA: 'Retry' Secondary: 'View rate limits'
2) Billing-quota (plan cap): Title: 'Plan quota reached' Body: 'Your team has used the monthly quota for this plan. Upgrade to increase limits or request a quota raise.' CTA: 'Upgrade plan' Secondary: 'Contact billing'
3) Mixed fallback (generic): Title: 'Request blocked' Body: 'This request was blocked due to quota or rate limits. View details for next steps.' CTA: 'View details' Secondary: 'Contact support'
Lina: I prefer separating rate-limit vs quota messaging in code so UX shows the correct template. For rate limits, include a live countdown when available: 'Try again in ~45s.' For quotas, show percent used and reset date if available.
Mark: Implementation note: we can show a small progress bar or number like 'Usage: 95% of monthly quota' but ensure it's accessible (provide text alternative). Also cache the last-known reset timestamp to avoid extra API calls.
Rae: Microcopy nits: avoid 'exceeded' which is negative and legal prefers neutral phrasing. 'Limit reached' or 'quota reached' is better. Also prefer 'Upgrade' over 'Buy' to align with product language.
legal-bot: Also add a short privacy note if we show monetary cost or usage per user. For enterprise/private deployments, opt-out flag required to hide usage breakdown.
Ben: Small CTA wording debate: 'Upgrade plan' vs 'Request more quota'. For self-serve customers, 'Upgrade plan' is clearer. For large customers on contracts, 'Request a quota increase' should surface the contact form. We might show CTA based on customer type.
Lina: Accessibility checklist we should include in the PR:
- inline error role=\"alert\" with concise spoken text
- visual banner has color contrast AA and icon with aria-hidden=true
- countdown should be provided as text for SRs, not only visually
- CTAs are buttons with clear accessible names, no vague 'OK' labels
Mark: Localization: avoid embedded numbers like '60s' 12; write 'about one minute' to make translation easier. Keep strings under 80-100 chars.
Rae: Examples to finalize in thread (final candidates):
A) Rate-limit (user-friendly): 'Too many requests. Please wait about one minute and try again.' CTA: 'Retry' Link: 'See rate limits'
B) Quota (billing): 'Your team has reached the monthly quota for your plan. Upgrade to increase limits or contact billing to request more.' CTA: 'Upgrade plan' Link: 'Contact billing'
C) Generic (fallback): 'Request blocked due to quota or rate limits. View details for next steps.' CTA: 'View details' Link: 'Help center'
Ben: Also propose microcopy for details page: show exact scope (project/org), metric (tokens/requests), usage bar, reset date: 'Usage: 9,500 / 10,000 requests (95%) — resets on Jul 30, 2024.' Keep date locale-aware.
Lina: And provide keyboard shortcut hint for retry: show 'Press Enter to retry' in polite aria-live when the retry button is focused.
legal-bot: Confirmed: avoid 'you've' in legal copy; use 'you have' in billing notice variants. Also add link to terms when showing upgrade CTA.
infra-bot: Implementation note: we'll expose an error_type field in the API payload (rate_limit | quota | blocked) so client can render the right template. Also a 'retry_after_seconds' optional field for countdown.
Rae: Action items:
- @Ben & @Lina: finalize copy variants and i18n-safe phrasing (owner: Ben).
- @Mark: add accessible usage bar and countdown behaviors to the component PR.
- @infra-bot: ensure API returns error_type and retry_after_seconds (owner: infra).
- @legal-bot: review final billing-quota string before merge.
Rae: I'll update the Figma with the three variants and examples for enterprise vs self-serve.
Ben: I'll post the final strings here after legal checks.
Lina: Thanks team 44d
